imitate:
I imitate
a memory of belief
that I do not own.
imitation: To think that realistic fiction is by definition superior to imaginative fiction is to think imitation is superior to invention.

We can at last describe his tie, an Easter gift from a dressy butcher, his brother in law in Onhava: imitation silk, colour chocolate brown barred with red, the end tucked into the shirt between the second and third buttons — a Zemblan fashion of the nineteen thirties.
